summary.text: Sydney Davis is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 17 who assumed office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A nurse anesthetist and cattle producer, she previously served in the state House from 2021 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Sydney Davis earned a degree in nursing from Mount Marty College, and her career experience includes working as a registered nurse anesthetist and a cattle producer.
Davis represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 17 from 2021 to 2023 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 10, 2023, succeeding Arthur Rusch.

In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Senate Taxation Committee, and the Senate Health and Human Services Committee, where she is vice chair.
